titulo.alumno: An answer from the clinic · Health and instructions

intro: Part 3: an answer from the clinic. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In a medical instruction, distinguish a recommendation from an obligation: «bør» advises; «skal» indicates a rule that must be followed. Check the frequency and the duration as well as the medicine.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
